Package com.microservices.reservation.warehouse.services

Class SingleReservationServiceManagement

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.reservation.warehouse.services.SingleReservationServiceManagement
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReservationExecutor
@Service public class SingleReservationServiceManagement extends Object implements ReservationExecutor
Service class for managing single reservations, including interactions with various components and strategies for reservation handling.

This class implements ReservationExecutor and provides functionality to handle single reservations by interacting with storage services, installment services, and persisting reservation data.

  • Method Details

    • register

      @PostConstruct public void register()
      Registers this reservation strategy for single reservations during the initialization of the service.

      This method is called after the bean's properties have been set and is used to register the single reservation strategy with the global reservation management system.

      Specified by:
      register in interface ReservationExecutor

    • reserve

      public ReservationResponse reserve(ReservationRequest reservation, UUID debtor)
      Reserves a storage based on the provided reservation request and debtor information.

      This method finds the relevant warehouse, maps the reservation request to a reservation entity, generates an installment, and persists the reservation. The reservation status is initially set to ConfirmReserveEnum.NOT_CONFIRMED.

      Specified by:
      reserve in interface ReservationExecutor
      Parameters:
      reservation - the reservation request containing details for the reservation
      debtor - the unique identifier of the debtor
      Returns:
      a ReservationResponse containing the details of the persisted reservation
